segments.name: Water Infrastructure
segments.description: Owns and operates permanent pipeline, recycling, disposal, storage and landfill infrastructure to manage produced water for E&P companies over the life of a well.
segments.evidence: The Water Infrastructure segment consists of the Company's fixed infrastructure assets, including operations associated with our water distribution pipeline infrastructure, our water recycling facilities, our produced water gathering pipelines, SWDs, and our solids management facilities, primarily serving E&P companies.

segments.name: Water Services
segments.description: Provides well completion and production water services, rentals, mobile power, flowback and automation technology to exploration and production customers.
segments.evidence: The Water Services segment primarily consists of the Company's water-related services businesses, including water sourcing, water transfer, fluids hauling, water monitoring, water containment and water network automation, primarily serving E&P companies.

segments.name: Chemical Technologies
segments.description: Develops, manufactures and supplies specialty chemicals and technical water treatment expertise to pressure pumpers and oil and gas producers.
segments.evidence: The Chemical Technologies segment provides technical solutions, products and expertise related to chemical applications in the oil and gas industry.

revenueModel.text: Oil and gas customers pay fixed fees per barrel handled for water gathering, recycling, transportation and disposal, and pay for services, rentals and chemical products.
revenueModel.evidence: We primarily generate revenue through fixed fees per barrel handled, which may include gathering, transportation, recycling, or disposal, pursuant to long-term commercial agreements that may incorporate acreage dedications, MVCs, and periodic escalators.
